hubDescription.guides: Source-backed guides on watering, light, pots, pests and seasonal care, written to help you observe a plant before you change its care.
hubDescription.plants: Houseplant profiles organised by species: light, watering, humidity, temperature, pet information and care level, each with its sources.
hubDescription.blog: Source-backed posts on plant care: brown tips, soil mould, pots, tap water, grow lights, buying a healthy plant, seasonal checklists and shared care.
hubDescription.compare: Source-backed comparisons of plant care apps covering reminders, shared records, identification and pricing, with honest launch notes.
